name: Carnival of Cultures
description: Berlin's Carnival of Cultures is a four-day festival of food, music and dance with inspiration from around the world. It takes place at Blücherplatz in Kreuzberg and culminates in a giant final day street parade that moves across the borough to neighboring Neukölln. The festival features Brazilian Samba and Caipirinhas, Angolan Kizomba and Bombo Assada, and celebrates why Berlin is the cultural and party capital of Europe.
